parameters.name: Low/Mid Crossover
parameters.description: Sets the frequency that separates the low band from the mid band
parameters.notes: Lower values isolate more bass frequencies; higher values include more low-mids with bass

parameters.name: Mid/High Crossover
parameters.description: Sets the frequency that separates the mid band from the high band
parameters.notes: Lower values create brighter overall sound; higher values keep more presence in mids

parameters.name: Low Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the level where low band compression begins
parameters.notes: Lower threshold = more compression; -∞ bypasses low band

parameters.name: Low Ratio
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of low band compression

parameters.name: Low Volume
parameters.description: Output level for the low band after compression
parameters.notes: Use to compensate for gain reduction or reshape tonal balance

parameters.name: Mid Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the level where mid band compression begins
parameters.notes: Lower threshold = more compression; -∞ bypasses mid band

parameters.name: Mid Ratio
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of mid band compression
parameters.notes: Mids often need moderate ratios (4:1-6:1) for natural sound

parameters.name: Mid Volume
parameters.description: Output level for the mid band after compression
parameters.notes: Critical for vocal presence and instrument clarity

parameters.name: High Threshold
parameters.description: Sets the level where high band compression begins
parameters.notes: Lower threshold = more compression; -∞ bypasses high band

parameters.name: High Ratio
parameters.description: Controls the intensity of high band compression

parameters.name: High Volume
parameters.description: Output level for the high band after compression
parameters.notes: Adjust to control brightness or tame harshness

parameters.name: Input Level
parameters.description: Adjusts signal level entering Fruity Squeeze
parameters.notes: Higher input drives more waveshaping/harmonic distortion

parameters.name: Output Level
parameters.description: Final gain stage after all processing
parameters.notes: Use to match output to input level or adjust final loudness

parameters.name: Dry/Wet Mix
parameters.description: Blends compressed signal with original dry signal
parameters.notes: 50% enables parallel compression for more natural dynamics

metering.name: Input Meter
metering.description: Shows incoming signal level before processing

metering.name: Low Band Gain Reduction
metering.description: Visual feedback for low band compression amount

metering.name: Mid Band Gain Reduction
metering.description: Visual feedback for mid band compression amount

metering.name: High Band Gain Reduction
metering.description: Visual feedback for high band compression amount

metering.name: Output Meter
metering.description: Shows final output level after all processing
